title: Length of the Longest Valid Substring
summary: Given a string word and an array of strings forbidden, find the length of the longest substring of word that does not contain any substring from forbidden.
statement: Given a string word and an array of strings forbidden, find the length of the longest substring of word that does not contain any substring from forbidden.
constraints: A substring is valid when it contains no member of forbidden as a contiguous substring.
Every forbidden word has length at most ten.
Return the maximum valid substring length.
hints: Track the earliest allowed start for a window ending at each right index.
Only inspect suffixes ending at right of length at most ten.
When a forbidden suffix is found, move left just after its start; record the window length.
Every newly created forbidden occurrence must end at the newly added character, so these bounded suffix checks are sufficient.
editorial: Every newly created forbidden occurrence must end at the newly added character, so these bounded suffix checks are sufficient.

No forbidden text occurs, so the entire length three is valid.
